violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (deli slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was taken apart and sanitzed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Before engaging in an activity that requires a *HACCP PLAN, a *PERMIT applicant or *PERMIT HOLDER shall submit to the *REGULATORY AUTHORITY for *APPROVAL a properly prepared *HACCP PLAN as specified under § 8-201.14. Establishment to no longer vacuum seal deli meats until process is approved by RIDOH. Product was evaluated and voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of potato slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took slicer down at the time of inspection to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025
The dispenser above the 3-bay sink was observed with broken knobs and dispensing quaternary ammonium above 400ppm. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

The pre-flush spray hose at the dish machine is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025
